title: Weather
description: The temperature next to the clock, in °C or °F, with the humidity if you want it. From Open-Meteo, free and with no account.
author: ImSammyTTV

title: Bambu Lab
description: How your 3D print is going, in a small card over your game at the start, 25%, 50%, 75% and the end, with a message when it's done. Talks to the printer on your home network (LAN), not the cloud.
author: ImSammyTTV

title: Theme music
description: A game's theme plays quietly on its page and fades out when you leave, found on YouTube and played through its own player. Data saver, your own songs, and Next song if it picks the wrong one.
author: ImSammyTTV
